profile.description: Distributed GEMM with communication and independent FP64 reference.

timing_protocol.scope: one complete cold GEMM; warm repeated-input path failed output oracle

memory.scope: bin/*.elf program objects; not union of all ELF loads or physical area

research.hypothesis: Use N-wide contiguous output rows and map over the K inputs for each local row. The weight source DSR advances automatically by Nt after every FMA, replacing repeated inner-loop output/weight descriptor updates and scalar indexing. Preserve the K order, all four communication steps, full vector output transpose and FP16 precision. This revision uses the supported many-item pointer base followed by a DSD row offset; the prior address-of-element form failed CSL compilation.
research.falsification: Reject any output, communication, exit or protected-control failure; under 1.05x speedup; over 1.10x program memory; or failed full six-case/fresh paired confirmation. Measure both FFN shapes before cross-shape claims.

profile.description: Distributed GEMM with communication and independent FP64 reference.

timing_protocol.scope: one complete cold GEMM; warm repeated-input path failed output oracle

Accumulate N-wide vectors directly in the output ABI array with physical column strideMt+1 to distribute SRAM banks. Compare with the best full-tile map-K and column candidates; reject layout savings that lose cycle performance.

Preserve every N-column/K-term/communication phase, original ABI and FP16 accumulation order.
research.falsification: Reject any skipped tail/column/K-term/output, descriptor-address advancement error, changed precision/PE/timer/communication contract, fixed numerical or shutdown failure, memory above1.10x, speedup below1.05x or failed fresh six-case confirmation. Do not replace a faster qualified map-K or padding candidate.
